opt_files_kept.message: 備份檔沒有刪，請自行刪除：

opt_deleted_logs_files_one.message: 已刪除 $1 筆紀錄和 $2 個備份檔

opt_deleted_logs_files_other.message: 已刪除 $1 筆紀錄和 $2 個備份檔

opt_lock_block_help.message: 離開座位時不讓別人看密碼。鎖上後要通過系統驗證才能用。

opt_lock_block_tip.message:
小視窗、管理頁、網頁自動填入、快捷鍵、瀏覽器驗證視窗都要先驗證。
Windows 用 Windows Hello，Mac 用 Touch ID，其他系統用安全金鑰或手機，沒有備用的 PIN。
管理頁每次打開都要驗證。
鎖定不會加密硬碟上的資料。
擴充功能的資料夾搬家後要重新啟用。

opt_lock_enable.description: Checkbox label before the page knows which verification method is used.

opt_lock_enable_with.description: Checkbox label. $1 = 'Windows Hello', 'Touch ID' or wa_security_key_or_phone.

opt_lock_state_on.description: Shown next to the App lock section title.

opt_lock_state_off.description: Shown next to the App lock section title.

opt_lock_idle_before.description: Before the minutes input: 'Lock after [15] minutes of inactivity'.

opt_lock_idle_after.description: After the minutes input. See opt_lock_idle_before.

opt_lock_manual_help.message: 小視窗右上角的「鎖定」可以隨時手動鎖上。

opt_lock_unsupported.message: 這個瀏覽器不支援系統驗證，沒辦法用工具鎖定。

opt_lock_info_on.message: 已啟用。鎖住時要用 $1 驗證才能用。

opt_lock_info_off.message: 尚未啟用。啟用時會跳一次 $1 驗證。

opt_lock_info_no_platform.message: 這台電腦沒有內建的驗證器，啟用時瀏覽器會問你要用安全金鑰還是手機。

opt_block_fill.description: Section title on the Settings tab. Holds the autofill master switch, per-site autofill settings and never-ask sites.

opt_autofill_master.message: 打開登入頁時自動填入帳號密碼（總開關）

opt_site_master_off.message: 總開關關著，所有網站都不會自動填。

opt_site_col_accounts.description: Table column: number of saved accounts for the site.

opt_site_submit_tip.message:
自動填入成功、頁面上只有一個登入表單時才會按。
隔多久能再按，看自動點選的間隔預設值。

opt_site_dirty_one.description: Changes wait until the user clicks 'Apply'.

opt_site_dirty_other.description: Changes wait until the user clicks 'Apply'.

opt_never_empty.message: 目前沒有。在儲存提示上按「這個網站永遠不問」就會出現在這裡。
opt_never_empty.description: The quoted text is a button on the save prompt shown on web pages (content.js). Keep it the same as that button.

opt_remove.description: Tooltip of the x that removes a site from the never-ask list.

opt_click_help.message: 開到指定的網頁時，自動幫你點按鈕。

opt_click_tip.message:
同一頁有好幾條時照順序點，前一條點完才輪下一條。
每條最多等 15 秒。

opt_click_interval_help.message: 點過之後，隔多久才能再點。

opt_click_interval_tip.message:
每條規則可以自己填間隔，沒填的用這個。
「自動填完按登入」也用這個。
時間到不會自己再點，要重新開頁面或跳頁才會再點。

opt_logout_pause_help.message: 按了登出，隔多久才恢復自動點。

opt_logout_pause_tip.message:
只影響按登出的那個分頁裡的同一個網站。
填 0 不暫停。

opt_rule_empty.message: 還沒有規則。到要自動點的網頁按小視窗的「選要自動點的按鈕」，或按「＋ 新增」自己填。

opt_when_after_fill.description: Option of 'When to click'. Also named in opt_rule_tip_when.

opt_when_on_load.description: Option of 'When to click'. Also named in opt_rule_tip_when.

opt_missing_skip.description: Option of 'If the button doesn't appear'.

opt_missing_stop.description: Option of 'If the button doesn't appear'.

opt_missing_last_title.description: Tooltip when the option does not matter for the last rule.

opt_rule_field_host.description: Field name of an auto-click rule.

opt_rule_field_path.description: Field name of an auto-click rule: the URL path such as /login, or * for the whole site.

opt_rule_field_selector.description: Field name of an auto-click rule.

opt_rule_field_text.description: Field name of an auto-click rule.

opt_rule_field_when.description: Field name of an auto-click rule.

opt_rule_field_interval.description: Field name of an auto-click rule.

opt_rule_field_missing.description: Field name of an auto-click rule.

opt_rule_tip_host.message:
要自動點的網站，例如 example.com.tw。
可以貼整個網址，會自動拆成網站和網址。

opt_rule_tip_path.message:
只在這個網址的頁面點，例如 /login。
* 代表任意字元，整個網站填 *。

opt_rule_tip_selector.message:
指定要點哪個按鈕的語法（CSS selector），例如 #login。
不會寫的話，到網頁上選按鈕會自動產生。

opt_rule_tip_selector_edit.description: $1 = opt_rule_tip_selector. Shown on an existing rule.

opt_rule_tip_text.message:
按鈕上的字要跟這裡一樣才會點。
留空就只看選擇器。
選擇器找不到按鈕時，會改用這段文字找。

opt_rule_tip_when.message:
自動填完才點：要先存帳號，帳密填好、表單沒有空欄位才點。
頁面一打開就點：按鈕出現就點，不用存帳號。
opt_rule_tip_when.description: Option names must match opt_when_after_fill and opt_when_on_load.

opt_rule_tip_interval.message:
點過之後，隔多久才能再點。
留空用間隔預設值。

opt_rule_tip_missing.message:
輪到這條後最多等 15 秒。
跳過：換下一條。
停止：後面的都不點，換頁才重新開始。

opt_rule_no.description: $1 = position of the rule on its site.

opt_confirm_delete_rule.message: 要刪除 $1 的這條自動點選嗎？

opt_rule_text_cleared.message: 已清空按鈕文字，之後只看選擇器

opt_interval_placeholder.description: Placeholder of a small number input. $1 = default interval in seconds.

opt_rule_count_one.description: Shown next to the site name.

opt_rule_count_other.description: Shown next to the site name.

opt_rule_count_off_one.description: $1 = rules for the site, $2 = rules turned off.

opt_rule_count_off_other.description: $1 = rules for the site, $2 = rules turned off.

opt_rule_path_empty.message: 網址不能空白，整個網站請填 *

opt_rule_interval_invalid.message: 間隔要是 1 到 86400 的整數

opt_delete_all_help_before.description: Before the number of days: 'Everything goes to the Trash first and can be restored within [30] days.' Keep the trailing space in languages that use spaces.

opt_delete_all_help_after.description: After the number of days. See opt_delete_all_help_before.

opt_confirm_delete_all_one.message: 要把全部 $1 組密碼移到回收桶嗎？$2 天內可以復原。
opt_confirm_delete_all_one.description: $1 = number of passwords, $2 = days items stay in the Trash.

opt_confirm_delete_all_other.message: 要把全部 $1 組密碼移到回收桶嗎？$2 天內可以復原。
opt_confirm_delete_all_other.description: $1 = number of passwords, $2 = days items stay in the Trash.

opt_help_1.message: 到任何網站登入一次，畫面右上角會問「要儲存這組密碼嗎？」。
opt_help_1.description: The quoted text is the save prompt shown on web pages (content.js). Keep it the same as that prompt.

opt_help_2.message: 下次再開同一個網站，帳號密碼會自動填好。存了多組帳號時，點帳號欄位會跳清單讓你選，上下鍵選、Enter 填。

opt_help_3.message: 按 Ctrl+Shift+L（Mac 是 Command+Shift+L）直接把目前網站的帳密填進去。快捷鍵可以在擴充功能管理頁的「鍵盤快速鍵」改。
opt_help_3.description: 'Keyboard shortcuts' is the browser's own page name.

opt_help_4.message: 工具列的藍色鎖頭圖示可以看目前網站存的帳號、手動填入、複製密碼、產生強密碼。小視窗最上面的搜尋框可以搜所有網站的帳號，Enter 直接開那個網站。

opt_help_5.message: 註冊或改密碼時，點新密碼欄會多一個「產生強密碼」，按下去新密碼和確認欄一起填好。
opt_help_5.description: The quoted text is an item shown on web pages (content.js). Keep it the same as that item.

opt_help_6.message: 要自動按按鈕時，按小視窗的「選要自動點的按鈕」，在網頁上選那顆按鈕，之後開到那一頁就會自動點。也可以在「設定」分頁的「自動點選」手動新增和調整。

opt_help_7.message: 改過密碼的帳號，表格的密碼欄會有「舊密碼」可以展開。刪掉的帳號先進回收桶，預設放 30 天，天數可以在回收桶分頁改。

opt_help_8.message: 「設定」分頁的「工具鎖定」開啟後，整個工具都要先用這台電腦的系統驗證（Windows Hello、Touch ID）才能用；閒置、瀏覽器重開、小視窗按「鎖定」都會鎖上。

opt_help_9.message: 記得定期備份，或打開自動備份。移除擴充功能、清除瀏覽資料、或把資料夾搬走，密碼就會不見。

opt_browser_hint.message: 你現在用的是 $1。擴充功能的管理頁在 $2，更新程式後要在那裡按「重新載入」。
opt_browser_hint.description: $1 = 'Edge' or 'Chrome', $2 = edge://extensions or chrome://extensions. 'Reload' is the browser's own button name.

opt_version_now.message: 目前版本 $1。更新程式後要到擴充功能管理頁按「重新載入」。

opt_version_current.description: Badge next to the installed version in the list.

opt_version_note.description: $1 = one note of a version from changelog.js.

cs_err_ext_reloaded.message: 擴充功能已重新載入，請重新整理這個頁面

cs_err_no_response.description: Error when the extension's background service worker didn't answer. Usually shown after "Couldn't save: ".

cs_save.description: Button on the save-password card and on the auto-click confirmation card.

cs_cancel.description: Button on the auto-click confirmation card.

cs_banner_update_title.message: 要更新這個帳號的密碼嗎？
cs_banner_update_title.description: Title of the same card when the site already has this account saved with a different password.

cs_banner_show.description: Small button inside the password box that reveals the password. Keep it short.

cs_banner_hide.description: Same button after the password is revealed. Keep it short.

cs_banner_never.description: Link-style button on the save-password card. Stops asking to save passwords on this site.

cs_banner_no.description: Closes the save-password card without saving.

cs_banner_never_done.message: 之後在 $1 不會再問了。管理頁可以改回來。

cs_generate_filled_copied.message: 已填入產生的密碼，也複製到剪貼簿了。送出後記得按「儲存」。
cs_generate_filled_copied.description: "Save" is the button on the save-password card that appears after the form is submitted.

cs_generate_filled.message: 已填入產生的密碼。送出後記得按「儲存」。
cs_generate_filled.description: Same as cs_generate_filled_copied, when copying to the clipboard wasn't allowed.

cs_dropdown_locked.message: 已鎖定。點工具列的鎖頭圖示驗證身分，就會自動填入。
cs_dropdown_locked.description: Shown under a sign-in field while App lock is locked.

cs_dropdown_choose_account.description: Header of the account list under a sign-in field. $1 is the extension name (Password Keeper).

cs_dropdown_generate.description: Item in the list under a new-password field.

cs_dropdown_generate_hint.message: 填進新密碼和確認欄，選項在工具列小視窗
cs_dropdown_generate_hint.description: Second line under "Generate a strong password". Options means the password generator options.

cs_dropdown_no_username.description: Shown in the account list for a saved login without a username.

cs_click_cooldown.message: 剛剛自動點過，這次不點

cs_click_missed_stop.description: $1 is the button text (up to 20 characters). The rule is set to stop when its button is missing, so the rules after it on this page are skipped.

cs_click_button_fallback.description: Used as $1 in the auto-click messages when the button has no text.

cs_click_done.description: $1 is the button text (up to 20 characters).

cs_click_not_found.message: 找不到要自動點的按鈕

cs_click_empty_field.message: 表單還有空欄位，這次沒有自動點

cs_pick_hint.message: 點要自動點的按鈕，Esc 取消
cs_pick_hint.description: Hint at the top of the web page while picking a button to auto-click.

cs_pick_untrusted_frame.message: 這裡是別的網站框進來的，不能自動點
cs_pick_untrusted_frame.description: The picked button is inside a frame embedded from a different site.

cs_pick_title.description: Title of the card shown after picking a button to auto-click.

cs_pick_button.description: Label above the picked button's text.

cs_pick_no_text.description: Shown when the picked button has no text.

cs_pick_note_no_account.message: 這個網站還沒存帳號，存了才會點

cs_pick_saved.message: 已儲存，下次開這一頁就會自動點

cs_fill_failed.description: Shown in the popup when filling the page failed.

bg_vault_unreadable.message: 密碼資料解不開，儲存空間可能壞掉了。可以到管理頁把資料全部清掉重來。

bg_url_scheme_unsupported.message: 只能存 http 或 https 開頭的網站

bg_duplicate_account.message: 這個網站已經有同一個帳號了

bg_webauthn_wrong_origin.message: 驗證來源不是這個擴充功能

bg_webauthn_unknown_key.message: 不是這個擴充功能登記的鑰匙
bg_webauthn_unknown_key.description: The key is the passkey created for app lock (Windows Hello, Touch ID, a security key or phone).

bg_webauthn_no_user_verification.message: 沒有通過本人驗證（PIN、指紋或臉）

bg_gen_symbols_empty.message: 有勾特殊符號，但允許的符號是空的
bg_gen_symbols_empty.description: Password generator in the popup: the symbols checkbox is on but the allowed symbols field is empty.

bg_gen_too_short.message: 字數太少，放不下每一種字元

bg_backup_password_too_short.message: 備份密碼至少 8 個字

bg_not_backup_file.message: 這不是密碼小管家的備份檔

bg_file_missing.description: Shown under a file location in the backup history: the file was moved or deleted.

bg_download_interrupted_reason.description: $1 is the browser's reason code, like USER_CANCELED.

bg_backup_location_changed.description: Saved in the backup history when the auto backup folder changes, in the language in use at that time. $1 is the old folder, $2 is the new folder.

bg_enable_needs_password.message: 先設定自動備份密碼才能啟用

bg_auto_backup_no_password.message: 還沒設定自動備份密碼
bg_auto_backup_no_password.description: Also saved as the last auto backup error, in the language in use at that time.

bg_backup_file_auto.description: File name, without the .pkbak extension, of a scheduled auto backup. $1 is the date and time, like 20261106-1200. Don't use these characters: \ / : * ? " < > |

bg_backup_file_now.description: File name, without the .pkbak extension, of a backup made with "Back up now". $1 is the date and time, like 20261106-1200. Don't use these characters: \ / : * ? " < > |

bg_badge_locked.description: Badge text on the toolbar icon while the extension is locked. The badge fits only about 4 characters.

bg_rule_path_required.message: 網址不能空白，整個網站請填 *

bg_label_pause.description: Field name used as $1 in bg_seconds_range: the "pause after sign-out" seconds on the manager page.

bg_duplicate_click_rule.message: 這個網址已經有相同選擇器的規則

bg_autofill_off_for_site.message: 這個網站的自動填入關著，先打開才能設定

bg_rules_changed.message: 規則有變動，請重新整理這一頁

bg_trash_not_found.message: 回收桶裡找不到這一筆

bg_restore_duplicate.message: 這個網站已經有同一個帳號了，先把那一筆刪掉才能復原

bg_trash_days_range.message: 天數要在 1 到 365 之間

bg_log_not_found.message: 找不到這筆紀錄，可能已經刪掉了

bg_unknown_message.description: $1 is an internal message type. Only shown when something inside the extension goes wrong.

lang_name_en.description: Shown in the language menu. Always written in that language itself, so people can find their language.

lang_name_ja.description: Shown in the language menu. Always written in that language itself, so people can find their language.
